summary: Customer inquired about home loan prepayment charges and waiver.

intents.keywords: नमस्ते मैं अरुण यादव ... प्री पेमेंट चार्ज कितना होगा?

issues.issue: Customer wants to know the prepayment charge for their home loan.

intents.actions of agent: Agent checked the prepayment charge and informed the customer.
intents.resolution: Agent informed the customer that the prepayment charge is 2%, which amounts to ₹10,000.

intents.keywords: क्या इसे माफ कर सकते हैं?

issues.issue: Customer is requesting a waiver of the prepayment charge.

intents.actions of agent: Agent said they would submit a request for a waiver.
intents.Process Request: Agent will submit a waiver request.
intents.resolution: Agent will submit a request for a waiver and provide an update in 3-5 days.
